# SEO / GEO audit: Brightside Dental

## Critical
1. **`src/_includes/base.njk:8`**: The canonical points to `staging.brightside-dental.example`. It should use the production origin from `geo.config.json:1` (`https://www.brightside-dental.example`). As written, every page tells search engines to index the staging host.
2. **`src/services.njk:5`**: `noindex: true` on the main money page, which is also listed in `src/sitemap.xml:4`. Remove the `noindex`. The sitemap and the noindex currently contradict each other.
3. **`src/contact.njk:10`**: The JSON-LD has a trailing comma after `"telephone"`, so it is invalid JSON and parsers will ignore it. Remove the comma. While you're there, add `address`, `url`, `openingHours`, `image`, `priceRange` and `sameAs`. The address (12 Park Row, Leeds) is currently only in the visible text at line 7.

## High
4. **`src/team.njk:1-4`**: There is no `description` in the front matter, so `base.njk:7` renders an empty meta description. Add one, and add a default fallback in the layout.
5. **`src/team.njk:6`** and **`src/index.njk:7`**: "Decades of experience" and "Trusted by thousands" are vague claims. The team page has no names, credentials, GMC numbers or bios, and no `Person` schema. AI engines and E-E-A-T signals need named, verifiable dentists. For a YMYL (health) site this matters a lot.
6. **`src/services.njk:8-9`**: The services are a bare list with no descriptions, no pricing and no per-service pages. "Our prices are simple and clear" shows no prices. Add a section per treatment with concrete details, FAQs and `Service` / `FAQPage` markup.
7. **`src/_includes/base.njk:2`**: `<html>` has no `lang` attribute. Use `lang="en-GB"`.

## Medium
8. **`src/_includes/base.njk:4-9`**: There are no Open Graph or Twitter tags, no `og:image`, and no site-wide `Organization` / `WebSite` JSON-LD. Add them in the layout.
9. **`src/index.njk:8`**: `/img/reception.jpg` does not exist in the repo, and `.eleventy.js:1` doesn't passthrough-copy an `img` directory. The image will 404. The image also lacks `width`, `height` and `loading` attributes.
10. **`src/sitemap.xml:3-7`**: It is hand-written, has no `<lastmod>`, and will drift from the real pages. Generate it from the Eleventy collections using `page.date` and the origin from `geo.config.json`. It also omits nothing that should be indexed, so keep it consistent with the noindex fixes above.
11. **`src/robots.txt:1-3`**: `geo.config.json:1` sets `aiSearchCrawlers: allow`, but robots.txt only has `User-agent: *`. Add explicit groups for `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `Google-Extended` and similar, to match that policy. Also add `Disallow: /thanks/`.
12. **`src/contact.njk:8`**: `data-nosnippet` hides the insurance terms from snippets and AI answers. That is useful information, so remove it unless you want it hidden.
13. **No `llms.txt`**: Add `src/llms.txt` with a site summary and key links, and add it to the passthrough copy in `.eleventy.js`.

## Low
14. **`src/_includes/base.njk:6`**: Titles are fine, but `index.njk:3` produces "Family dentist in Leeds | Brightside Dental". Consider a more targeted homepage title.
15. **`.eleventy.js:1`**: The whole config is on one line. Reformat it, and move the origin into global data (`src/_data/site.js`) so the canonical, sitemap and robots all share a single source.
16. **No 404 page, no favicon, and no visible NAP in the layout footer** (`base.njk:13-14`). Add a footer with the address, phone number and opening hours on every page.
17. **`src/thanks.njk:5`**: `noindex` is correct. Keep it, and add it to the robots.txt `Disallow` (see item 11).

I haven't changed any files. Want me to apply the fixes?
